capabilities: record microphone audio as MP3 files in a vault folder
plot a self-contained audio-player rectangle onto Excalidraw drawings
serve generated player pages through a local HTTP server
regenerate the HTML player pages for every MP3 in the recordings folder
replot the last recording if the drawing view was closed first
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.4.0+); the plotted rectangle only loads while the plugin's local server runs on the same PC, though the MP3 and HTML files stay valid elsewhere. Listed as not staff-reviewed and installable via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Neither Excalidraw nor its plugin can record audio
motivation: The author wanted to fix Excalidraw's unresolved lack of audio recording (issue #2278) by automating card creation with the recording included.
problem: Excalidraw cannot record audio, and even embedding an existing audio file in a drawing requires a manual workaround with a card and an audio link.

relations.evidence: the ExcalidrawAutomate API that makes the drawing part possible
relations.plugin: Excalidraw for Obsidian by Zsolt Viczián

summary: Records voice notes as MP3 files and plots a self-contained audio player where you recorded, in a note or on an Excalidraw drawing.
